summary: Iteration 97 – tested §8-11. Backend: 16 pytest (roles-permissions level strings fix, roles/all + roles/meta rename/(de)activate with a TEST role + TEST user (403 'Votre rôle est désactivé' then reactivated), unsellable declare/approve/reject/outcomes with stock checks + movements, cash declare-handover analysis/validate/reject on TEST sessions) → 15/16 pass (qty=0 silently becomes 1). UI: Équipe hub (3 tabs, /console/presences + /console/roles redirect, single sidebar entry), roles matrix (47 rows built from menu + 'Autres onglets', change cell → 'Matrice enregistrée'), user-role select from /roles/all, Stock › Non vendables full flow (Gérante declares incl. '+ motif' → owner validates → en réparation → remis en stock, history shown, stock back to 4), cash blind count (no expected shown) → owner validate modal with cash-verdict 'Écart de +1 000 FCFA' + cash-analysis + attention, StoreLocation (geoloc → coords + Google iframe, manual lat/lng incl. comma decimal, invalid → error toast, map pick modal), storefront hours-exception-banner (exception injected in DB), POS pos-stock-rule, manual section add-v3-stock-rule present in module 1. MAIN FAILURE: the opening-hours exceptions editor (exc-date/exc-add-date/…/exc-save) is not reachable anywhere in the console. All test data cleaned; permission matrix, opening_hours, business coords and role_meta restored/verified identical to before.

minor.issue: qty=0 is silently converted to 1 (`int(body.get('qty') or 1)`) instead of 400; non-numeric qty → int() ValueError → 500

cash_movements/orders are filtered only by time range (opened_at..closed_at or '9999'), not by session/store; for an unvalidated session the window is open-ended so movements after the count are included at validation time

ui_bugs.issue: Exceptional closures / special hours editor is unreachable: OpeningHoursEditor is only used by pages/console/SiteSettings.jsx, which is imported in App.js but never routed (/console/site renders SiteVitrine). Settings › Coordonnées uses WeekGrid (no exceptions UI). exc-date, exc-add-date, exc-closed, exc-special, exc-reason, exc-show, exc-message, exc-save not found on /console/parametres?tab=coordonnees nor /console/site
/console/stock?tab=invendables does not open the 'Non vendables' tab (tab state from useKeptState only, ignores ?tab). Notifications for unsellable declarations link to this URL
copyAll() rebuilds opening_hours from DAYS only → drops opening_hours.exceptions when 'Copier partout' is used, then Save wipes exceptions

integration_issues.issue: Matrix is saved but never enforced: backend role_access.py uses hard-coded ROLE_API and api_allowed() returns True for any role not in ROLE_API → a user of a custom role has unrestricted access to every API not guarded by require_role. Frontend canAccess is also hard-coded. The matrix is cosmetic

issues: Duplicate 'Vendeuse' role: built-in 'sales' (Vendeuse) + legacy custom role key 'vendeuse' (db.roles) both shown in matrix columns and in user-role select
After 'Réparé · remettre en stock', status line still shows red 'En réparation' (status not updated); only the right label reflects outcome
'Par moyen de paiement' header shown with no rows when no sales; 'Sorties −0 FCFA'
Map modal reuses customer copy: 'Placer ma position' / 'Touchez la carte à l'endroit exact de livraison' – should say boutique
store-lat/store-lng inputs initialised once from value before /business loads → empty even when coordinates exist

action_items: Render OpeningHoursEditor (with ExceptionsEditor) in a reachable screen (Settings › Coordonnées instead of / next to WeekGrid, or route SiteSettings) so exc-* controls exist; keep exceptions when WeekGrid copyAll is used
Make StockInventories honour ?tab= (invendables) so notification links open the right tab
Validate qty strictly in POST /api/stock/unsellable (reject 0/non-integer with 400)
Enforce roles_permissions matrix (or at least deny-by-default for unknown/custom roles in role_access.api_allowed)
Remove/merge duplicate legacy 'vendeuse' custom role vs built-in 'sales'
Minor: unsellable row status after remis_en_stock; empty by_method section; store map modal wording; StoreLocation manual inputs sync with loaded value
critical_code_review_comments: role_access.api_allowed: `if rules is None: return True` gives custom roles full API access – security gap now that roles are dynamic
RolesPermissions save normalises admin {all:true} into 47 explicit keys and drops unknown keys (shape change on every save)

Deactivated-role users can still log in (/api/auth/* exempt) and then get 403 on every call – better to reject at login with the 'rôle désactivé' message; inactive_roles cache is per-process (30 s) – stale with multiple workers
GET /api/stock/unsellable returns full base64 photos for up to 500 rows – consider thumbnails/projection
server.py ~5950 lines – far over the 700-line guideline
